title: Scavenger Hunt in Salt Lake City by Crazy Dash
includes: 2 hours with a remote interactive guide
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: During Crazy Dash of Salt Lake City, you'll use an app and walk through the city to collect points by finding items around the city and performing challenges. You can find the items in any order you want. Check out the rankings in the app to see your score compared to other teams across the nation. Crazy Dash comes with a remote host to chat with you in case you need anything. Crazy Dash is our most relaxed scavenger hunt. Come explore with us in Salt Lake City!
